titre: Devoir de contrôle n°3 - Anglais (1ère année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Reading is a wonderful habit that many young people are losing today. Yet books offer countless benefits. First of all, reading improves our vocabulary and our writing skills. When we read regularly, we learn new words and expressions without even noticing. Moreover, books develop our imagination and our general knowledge: a good novel can take us to faraway countries and distant times. Reading also helps us relax after a tiring day and reduces stress. Unfortunately, many teenagers prefer to spend their time on their phones. That is why parents and teachers should encourage children to read from an early age. A person who reads is a person who grows.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What habit are many young people losing, according to the text?   (2 marks)
2) How does reading improve our language skills?   (2 marks)
3) Give two other benefits of reading mentioned in the text.   (2 marks)
4) What does the writer suggest parents and teachers should do?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb in the present simple: When we (read) ______ regularly, we learn new words.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with "should": Parents ______ encourage children to read.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): A person ______ reads is a person who grows.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "improve" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Why is reading important?" Write a paragraph (about 8-10 lines) explaining the benefits of reading, with examples. Use linkers.
